proposals.before: In the seventh year of Tonghe, on jiachen day of the first spring month the court went to Dali Mountain.
proposals.after: In the seventh year of Kaitai, on jiachen day of the first spring month the court went to Dali Mountain.
proposals.reason: The Chinese has only 七年; this volume continues 開泰 (Kaitai), not 統和 (Tonghe). Kaitai 7 is AD 1018. Tonghe was invented in the English.

proposals.before: In the seventh year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on jiachen day, went to Dali Mountain.
proposals.after: In the seventh year of Kaitai, spring, first month, on jiachen day, went to Dali Mountain.
proposals.reason: The Chinese era is inherited 開泰, not 統和. Literal English invented Tonghe.

proposals.before: On bingyin day of the fifth month Prince Zongzhen was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang; Zongyuan was made Yongqing Army military commissioner; Zongjian Right Guard senior general; Zongyuan Left Xiao Guard senior general; Zongwei Right Guard senior general; imperial nephew Zongfan Zhaoyi Army military commissioner; Zongxi Zhenguo Army military commissioner; Zongliang Jiang Prefecture military commissioner; Zongbi Pu Prefecture observation commissioner; Zongyi Cao Prefecture defense commissioner; and Zongxian and Zongsu both defense commissioners.
proposals.after: On bingyin day of the fifth month the imperial son Zongzhen was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang; Zongyuan (宗元) was made Yongqing Army military commissioner; Zongjian Right Guard senior general; Zongyuan (宗願) Left Xiao Guard senior general; Zongwei Right Guard senior general; imperial nephew Zongfan Zhaoyi Army military commissioner; Zongxi Zhenguo Army military commissioner; Zongliang Jiang Prefecture military commissioner; Zongbi Pu Prefecture observation commissioner; Zongyi Cao Prefecture defense commissioner; and Zongxian and Zongsu both defense commissioners.
proposals.reason: 皇子 is imperial son, not already Prince; 宗元 and 宗願 are two different men collapsed into the same English spelling Zongyuan.

proposals.before: On bingchen day an edict made Eastern Capital Prince Xiao Paiya supreme commander, Palace Front inspector general Xiao Xulie vice commander, and Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage inspector general for a campaign against Goryeo.
proposals.after: On bingchen day an edict made Prince of Dongping Xiao Paiya supreme commander, Palace Front inspector general Xiao Xulie vice commander, and Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage inspector general for a campaign against Goryeo.
proposals.reason: 東平郡王 is Prince of Dongping commandery, not Eastern Capital Prince (東京).

proposals.before: In the eighth year of Tonghe, in the first spring month Song sent Chen Yaozuo and Zhang Qun with congratulations.
proposals.after: In the eighth year of Kaitai, in the first spring month Song sent Chen Yaozuo and Zhang Qun with congratulations.
proposals.reason: The Chinese has only 八年; this volume continues 開泰 (Kaitai 8 = AD 1019), not 統和. Tonghe was invented in the English.

proposals.before: In the eighth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, Song sent Chen Yaozuo and Zhang Qun to congratulate.
proposals.after: In the eighth year of Kaitai, spring, first month, Song sent Chen Yaozuo and Zhang Qun to congratulate.
proposals.reason: Literal English invented Tonghe; the inherited era is 開泰.

proposals.before: On yihai day Eastern Capital Prince Xiao Hanning, Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage, imperial uncle-in-law Associate Grand Chancellor Xiao Paiya, linya Yaozhi, and others returned from the Goryeo campaign; charged with violating military discipline, their crimes were enumerated and they were released.
proposals.after: On yihai day Prince of Dongping Xiao Hanning, Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage, imperial uncle-in-law Associate Grand Chancellor Xiao Paiya, linya Yaozhi, and others returned from the Goryeo campaign; charged with violating military discipline, their crimes were enumerated and they were released.
proposals.reason: 東平王 is Prince of Dongping, not Eastern Capital Prince (東京).

proposals.before: In the ninth year of Tonghe, in the first spring month Song sent Liu Ping and Zhang Yuanpu with congratulations.
proposals.after: In the ninth year of Kaitai, in the first spring month Song sent Liu Ping and Zhang Yuanpu with congratulations.
proposals.reason: Chinese has only 九年; this volume is 開泰九年 (AD 1020), not 統和. Tonghe was invented in the English.

proposals.before: In the ninth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, Song sent Liu Ping and Zhang Yuanpu to congratulate.
proposals.after: In the ninth year of Kaitai, spring, first month, Song sent Liu Ping and Zhang Yuanpu to congratulate.
proposals.reason: Literal English invented Tonghe; inherited era is 開泰.

proposals.before: On xinhai day Goryeo King Xun sent envoys asking to resume tribute; an edict accepted their submission.
proposals.after: On xinhai day Wang Xun, king of Goryeo, sent envoys asking to resume tribute; an edict accepted their submission.
proposals.reason: 王詢 is the king's personal name, Wang Xun, not a title followed by the given name Xun.

proposals.before: On xinhai day, Goryeo King Xun dispatched envoys begging to submit tribute goods; edict accepted them.
proposals.after: On xinhai day Wang Xun, king of Goryeo, dispatched envoys asking to submit tribute goods; an edict accepted them.
proposals.reason: 王詢 is the personal name Wang Xun; the old English misread 王 as 'king.'

proposals.before: On gengwu day of the fifth month Yelü Zizhong returned from a mission to Goryeo; King Xun submitted a memorial asking to resume vassal status and tribute and to return the detained Liao envoy Zhilali.
proposals.after: On gengwu day of the fifth month Yelü Zizhong returned from a mission to Goryeo; Wang Xun submitted a memorial asking to resume vassal status and tribute, and returned the detained Liao envoy Zhilali.
proposals.reason: 王詢 is Wang Xun, and 歸所留王人只剌裏 says that he returned the detained Liao envoy Zhilali.

proposals.before: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, Yelü Zizhong returned from a mission to Goryeo; King Xun submitted a memorial requesting to call himself a vassal and submit tribute and to return the detained Liao envoy Zhilali.
proposals.after: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, Yelü Zizhong returned from a mission to Goryeo; Wang Xun submitted a memorial requesting vassal status and permission to submit tribute, and returned the detained Liao envoy Zhilali.
proposals.reason: 王詢 is Wang Xun's personal name. The source says he returned the detained envoy, not that he requested the envoy's return.

proposals.before: On xinwei day envoys were dispatched to absolve King Xun and grant his request.
proposals.after: On xinwei day envoys were dispatched to absolve Wang Xun and grant his request.

proposals.before: On xinwei day, dispatched envoys to release King Xun from guilt and granted his request.
proposals.after: On xinwei day envoys were dispatched to absolve Wang Xun and grant his request.

proposals.before: On dingchou day Song envoy Xue Yikuo came announcing that Song Emperor Zhen had died and his son Zhen had succeeded.
proposals.after: On dingchou day Song envoy Xue Yikuo came announcing that Song Emperor Heng had died and his son Zhen had succeeded.

proposals.before: On renyin day of the tenth winter month palace rear official Zhang Kegong was sent to congratulate Western Xia King Li Dezhao on his birthday; Yelü Saogu and Han Wang to congratulate the Song empress dowager on her birthday; and Yelü Xianning and Shi Kezhong to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
proposals.after: On renyin day of the tenth winter month palace rear official Zhang Kegong was sent to congratulate Li Dezhao, king of Western Xia, on his birthday; Yelü Saogu and Han Yuxian served as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song empress dowager on her birthday; and Yelü Xianning and Shi Kezhong served as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
proposals.reason: The received 韓王 is a textual corruption of Han Yuxian's name 韓玉賢, as shown by the parallel Song record and the Liao History collation note; he was not a person named Han Wang.

proposals.before: Winter, tenth month, on renyin day palace rear official Zhang Kegong was dispatched as envoy to congratulate Western Xia King Li Dezhao on his birthday; Yelü Saogu and Han Wang as envoys to congratulate the Song empress dowager on her birthday; and Yelü Xianning and Shi Kezhong as envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
proposals.after: In the tenth winter month, on renyin day, palace rear official Zhang Kegong was dispatched as envoy to congratulate Li Dezhao, king of Western Xia, on his birthday; Yelü Saogu and Han Yuxian served as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song empress dowager on her birthday; and Yelü Xianning and Shi Kezhong served as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
proposals.reason: The parallel Song record identifies the received 韓王 as Han Yuxian (韓玉賢), and 使副 denotes the paired chief and deputy envoys.

proposals.reason: 王詢 is Wang Xun, and his son 欽 inherits the Wang surname; the old English misread 王 as the title 'King.'
